trim.title: Remove what follows?
trim.body: This reply and everything before it stay. Everything after it is removed and cannot be brought back.
trim.blocked: Settle its rename, close or delete first.
trim.busy: A reply is running. Try again when it ends.
trim.cannot: This chat cannot be cut here.
trim.gone: This chat is not open on its computer, so nothing was removed.
trim.refused: The agent did not remove anything.
